value.basis: Published Corsi forward spans in young adults (Kessels et al. 2000; computerized eCorsi/PsyToolkit variants) average about 6–6.5 with SDs near 1.1–1.3 under the same two-trials-per-length, stop-at-two-failures rule; unproctored online administration and lapses pull the mean slightly down, while the 900/300 ms pacing and 'longest length with one correct' scoring are close to standard and shift little.
